title: Unauthorized Location Tracking
description: Child's GPS coordinates are transmitted to backend without explicit consent or appropriate privacy controls, enabling continuous location tracking of the child.
assumptions: Assumes child may not be aware of or consent to this data transmission.

title: Location Information Disclosure
description: Child's location information is shared with backend system, potentially exposing sensitive personal data about the child's whereabouts.
assumptions: Assumes location data is considered sensitive personal information.

title: Personal Data Transmission
description: GPS coordinate data (personal data) is transmitted from child's device to backend, creating potential privacy risks if data is mishandled or accessed by unauthorized parties.
assumptions: Assumes GPS coordinates constitute personal data under applicable privacy regulations.

title: Unauthorized Data Access
description: Backend system may have unauthorized access to child's location data, potentially allowing improper use or disclosure of sensitive location information.
assumptions: Assumes backend system may have insufficient access controls.

title: Privacy Regulation Non-Compliance
description: Data transmission of child's location may not comply with applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, COPPA) requiring consent, minimization, and purpose limitation.
assumptions: Assumes applicable privacy regulations exist and require specific protections for child location data.

title: Location data stored in Location History Store
description: Mobile App Backend writes location pings to Location History Store, resulting in explicit disclosure of personal location data. This storage may be avoidable if not strictly required for the intended purpose.
assumptions: Location data is considered personal data under applicable privacy regulations

title: Implicit disclosure through location metadata
description: Location data stored in DS1 may contain implicit personal information through metadata or derived patterns that could be used to infer user behavior, movements, and routines without explicit consent.
assumptions: Location data includes timestamps and geolocation coordinates

title: Unauthorized access to Location History Store
description: Location History Store may be accessed by unauthorized parties without proper authentication and authorization controls, leading to potential exposure of sensitive location data.
assumptions: DS1 has appropriate access controls in place

title: Data loss in Location History Store
description: Location data stored in DS1 may be lost due to system failures, corruption, or deletion, resulting in loss of user location history.
assumptions: DS1 has appropriate backup and recovery mechanisms

title: Location data disclosure to Geofencing Engine
description: Location pings containing personal location data are transferred from Mobile App Backend to Geofencing & Alert Engine. This represents an explicit data disclosure across a process boundary where personal data is shared with another system component.
assumptions: Location pings contain identifiable personal data about user movements

title: Inference of sensitive user information from location data
description: Location pings transferred to Geofencing Engine may be used to infer sensitive information about the user such as health status, social activities, or private movements, which could exceed the scope of the original data collection purpose.
assumptions: Geofencing Engine processes location data for zone detection and may derive additional insights

title: Unintended data exposure through geofencing alerts
description: Location data transferred to Geofencing Engine may be exposed in unintended ways through alert notifications, logs, or system interactions that could reveal user location patterns to unauthorized parties.
assumptions: Geofencing Engine may generate alerts or logs that contain location information

title: Potential non-compliance with data transfer regulations
description: The transfer of location data from Mobile App Backend to Geofencing Engine may not comply with applicable privacy regulations regarding data sharing between system components, particularly if proper consent or data minimization is not ensured.
assumptions: Data transfer between processes may not have explicit regulatory compliance measures in place

title: Location data in zone definitions
description: The Family Account Store contains location-based zone definitions (home, school, friend's house) that reveal sensitive personal location information about family members and their daily routines.

title: Information disclosure about family routines
description: Zone definitions disclose detailed information about family members' daily patterns, locations, and social connections, which could be used to infer personal habits and relationships.

title: Unauthorized access to zone definitions
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may access zone definitions without proper authorization or consent, potentially exposing sensitive location data to unauthorized parties.

title: Lack of Control over Notification Content
description: The Geofencing Engine (P2) may not have adequate controls to ensure that only authorized and accurate arrival/departure notifications are sent to the parent entity (EE1), potentially allowing unauthorized data disclosure or manipulation.

title: Data Deception in Location Notifications
description: The arrival/departure notifications sent by P2 to EE1 could be manipulated or contain false location information, potentially misleading the parent entity about actual geofencing events.

title: Unintended Privacy Consequences from Location Disclosure
description: Sending geofencing notifications to EE1 may inadvertently reveal sensitive location patterns or movement data that could be used for profiling or tracking individuals.

title: Lack of Control over Notification Reception
description: The parent entity (EE1) may not have adequate controls to verify the authenticity and integrity of notifications received from P2, potentially allowing spoofed or tampered data.

title: Unauthorized access to child profile during registration
description: Parent may not be the only authorized party accessing the child's profile information during account creation. Unauthorized actors could potentially intercept or access the registration data.
assumptions: Assumes registration process is not fully authenticated and encrypted

title: Confidentiality of personal data during transmission
description: Personal information (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) transmitted from parent to mobile app backend may be exposed during network transmission if not properly encrypted.
assumptions: Assumes standard network transmission without guaranteed encryption

title: Information leakage of sensitive child data
description: Sensitive child profile information could be leaked to unauthorized parties during the registration process, potentially exposing the child's personal details to third parties.
assumptions: Assumes no proper access controls on the mobile app backend

title: Data integrity of child profile information
description: Personal information (name, DOB, school, geofence zones) stored in the mobile app backend could be altered, corrupted, or tampered with without proper integrity controls.
assumptions: Assumes no proper integrity controls on the mobile app backend

title: Parent accessing child's location data
description: Parent (ExternalEntity) requests to view child's current location or location history, which may involve unauthorized or excessive location data access beyond what is necessary for the stated purpose.
assumptions: Parent has legitimate access to child's location data through the mobile app

title: Location data disclosure to parent
description: Mobile App Backend discloses child's location information to parent, which may include sensitive personal data that could be misused or shared beyond intended recipients.
assumptions: Location data is transmitted from the mobile app backend to the parent's device

title: Information revelation about child's location
description: Mobile App Backend reveals information about child's location patterns and history, which may create privacy concerns regarding the child's movement and whereabouts.
assumptions: Location history is stored and transmitted to parent

title: Location History Retrieval
description: Location history data is retrieved from the data store to the mobile app backend, potentially exposing sensitive user movement patterns and location-based behavior that could be used for profiling or tracking.

title: Information Overexposure
description: The location history data retrieved may contain more detailed or comprehensive information than necessary for the stated purpose of serving the parent's map/history view, potentially exceeding user expectations.

title: Data Transfer Risk
description: Location history data is transferred from the data store to the process, creating a potential point where data could be intercepted, logged, or mishandled during the transfer.

title: Unintended Data Usage
description: The retrieved location history data could potentially be used for purposes beyond the stated map/history view function, such as targeted advertising or behavioral profiling without explicit user consent.

title: Unauthorized disclosure of child location to secondary guardian
description: Parent may share child's location data with a secondary guardian without proper authorization or consent, potentially violating the child's privacy expectations and data protection principles.
assumptions: Parent has authority to invite secondary guardians but may not fully consider privacy implications

title: Interception of location data during transmission
description: Location data transmitted from parent to mobile app backend may be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transit, potentially exposing sensitive location information.
assumptions: Data transmission occurs over potentially unsecured channels

title: Inappropriate processing of location data by mobile app backend
description: Mobile app backend may process or store child's location data in ways that exceed the original purpose of sharing with secondary guardian, potentially leading to broader data exposure.
assumptions: Backend has access to location data and may use it for purposes beyond the original invitation

title: Unintended consequences of location sharing
description: Sharing child's location with secondary guardian may have unintended consequences such as tracking, surveillance, or misuse of location data by the secondary guardian.
assumptions: Secondary guardian may not use location data appropriately or may share it further

title: Unauthorized Location Sharing
description: Live location data is shared with secondary guardian without explicit consent or proper authorization mechanisms

title: Information Disclosure to Unauthorized Parties
description: Child's location information may be disclosed to unauthorized parties or without proper access controls

title: Location Data Integrity During Transmission
description: Live location data may be altered, corrupted, or tampered with during transmission to secondary guardian

title: Excessive Data Retention
description: Location data may be retained longer than necessary for the intended purpose of sharing with secondary guardian

title: Unintended Consequences of Location Sharing
description: Sharing live location with secondary guardian may have unintended privacy consequences for the child or other family members

title: Privacy Regulation Non-Compliance
description: Location sharing may not comply with applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, COPPA) regarding minors' data protection

title: Unauthorized Disclosure of User Analytics
description: Aggregated usage and engagement analytics shared with external advertising partner may contain personally identifiable information or be used for purposes beyond the intended scope, leading to unauthorized disclosure of user behavior patterns.

title: Unintended Use of Shared Analytics
description: Advertising partner may repurpose the shared analytics data for purposes other than funding the free tier, such as building user profiles or selling data to other third parties.

title: Regulatory Non-Compliance in Data Sharing
description: Sharing user analytics with external advertising partner may violate privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) without obtaining explicit user consent or providing adequate privacy notices.

title: Inadequate Security Controls at External Partner
description: Advertising/analytics partner may have insufficient security measures, increasing risk of data breach or unauthorized access to the shared analytics data.

title: Non-repudiation of SOS message
description: The system may not be able to prove that the SOS/check-in message was actually sent by the specific child user, as the message could be forged or the origin could be disputed.
assumptions: Assumes the system relies on manual input without strong authentication or digital signatures.

title: Location data confidentiality during transmission
description: The child's current location data sent in the SOS/check-in message could be intercepted by unauthorized parties during transmission to the Mobile App Backend.
assumptions: Assumes the communication channel may not be fully encrypted or protected.

title: Data integrity of location information
description: The location data sent by the child could be corrupted, altered, or tampered with during transmission to the Mobile App Backend.
assumptions: Assumes the transmission channel may not be fully protected against tampering.

title: Availability of SOS message processing
description: The Mobile App Backend may fail to receive or process the SOS/check-in message, leaving the child without help when needed.
assumptions: Assumes the system may experience failures, network issues, or resource constraints.
